value.text:
Two ways to merge an offline edit, and I need your call before S2 starts:

- **(a) Last write wins per note.** Simple and fast, but one of two offline edits to the same note is lost.
- **(b) Merge per paragraph.** Edits to different paragraphs both survive; only a same-paragraph clash asks the writer.

I recommend (b): your words say nobody should ever lose …

note: This is the behaviour I want.
replies.text: Go with (b). Our users write long notes on flights, so losing a whole note is the one thing we can't ship.
